prompt: Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with knee injury after a rear-end collision. The patient had 17 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1102; do not mention it.)
text:
The patient presented following a rear-end motor vehicle collision with acute right knee pain, swelling, and reduced range of motion. Initial examination revealed effusion and tenderness along the medial joint line, with a positive McMurray test and mild instability on valgus stress. Imaging was obtained to rule out fracture, and no bony abnormality was identified. A working diagnosis of right medial meniscal injury with associated soft tissue strain was established.

Over the course of 17 visits, treatment consisted of a structured physical therapy program focusing on quadriceps and hamstring strengthening, progressive weight-bearing, and gait retraining. Anti-inflammatory medication and cryotherapy were used during the acute phase to control swelling and pain. The patient's effusion resolved over the first several weeks, and range of motion improved to near full flexion and extension.

At the most recent evaluation, the patient reported significant improvement in pain and function, with residual discomfort limited to prolonged kneeling and stair descent. Strength deficits have narrowed but not fully resolved. Continued home exercise and activity modification are recommended, with re-evaluation if mechanical symptoms or instability recur.
